meta.title: jss-devtools init: command flow across modules
meta.subtitle: As plan 261027-1541-init-node-preset builds it. Create mode first, then what existing mode checks instead.
meta.description: Every check is read only and runs before the first write. Errors are drawn as red returns; each one is an exit 1 with what was found and the next step.

views.title: 1. Arguments and mode
views.narrative: init.command.ts parses with commander and rejects a wrong-mode flag or an unbuilt framework before any I/O.

views.title: 2. Create-mode preflight
views.narrative: The package manager is asked (or --pm, or npm with -y), then the folder, git and <pm> --version are checked.

views.title: 3. Existing-mode preflight
views.narrative: package.json, monorepo, tsconfig.json, .git here, core.hooksPath, the detected manager, and the owned config names, in that order.

views.title: 4. Plan, dry run, confirm
views.narrative: The service returns a plan of + ~ - entries. --dry-run renders it and exits 0; otherwise the user confirms or the run exits 1.

views.title: 5. Write, install, sort
views.narrative: git init (create only), the writes with deletions last, the install with its output passed through, then prettier-package-json and prettier from the project itself.
